parsed.notes:
The heading “Das bringst du idealerweise mit:” makes the entire qualifications section optional, including German.
The five Azure-service examples form one alternative group for the single Azure Data services ask; Microsoft Foundry is a separate interest clause.
BI Cloud Architecture is read literally as naming business intelligence, cloud and architecture; the software-architecture mapping is flagged for review because the taxonomy has no dedicated cloud-architecture entry.
AI-supported personalization and Predictive Marketing are technical techniques without matching taxonomy entries; Customer Intelligence is treated as excluded domain knowledge.
Technologies appearing only in responsibilities or benefits are not labeled.
